narratives.body: Multiple sources report a Thursday Night Football matchup between the New England Patriots and the Chicago Bears scheduled for October 23, 2026. Reports from Yahoo Sports, Asbury Park Press, and others confirm the game is set for Week 7 at Soldier Field in Chicago. Several outlets, including Yahoo Sports and NBC 5 Chicago, note that the Bears will honor Mike Ditka during the game, with some headlines specifically mentioning his mustache. Other reports focus on player inactives, weather forecasts, betting predictions, and streaming options for the broadcast. One report from theScore mentions a previous Bears game against the Atlanta Falcons on October 18, 2026, but the primary focus remains on the upcoming Patriots-Bears game.
narratives.headline: Patriots vs. Bears: Thursday Night Football details and Mike Ditka tribute
